April's Spotlight Falls on Rookie Star
<Manchester:team#358>'s <Miguel Rodriguez:player#137749> collected 13 hits to snare the British National Baseball League Rookie of the Month for April.

He batted .591 with 2 home runs, 9 RBIs and 11 runs scored.

The 20-year-old is barely old enough to shave, but he could definitely contend for Rookie of the Year if he keeps up this pace.
